meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 软件开发工程师与信息安全分析师在构建多智能体系统时，当需全链路可观测与安全审计，请用此技能。它自动收集操作日志，生成可追溯证据链与向量索引，开箱即用实现系统审计与精准回放，让Agent运行安全透明。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 收集Agent操作日志，构建可溯源证据链，实现安全审计与精准回放。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在构建多智能体系统，需要全链路可观测与安全审计。
copy.tagline_en: Collect agent operation logs as evidence chains for audit and replay.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building multi-agent systems and need full observability and audit trails.

howto.what: 装上后，各智能体在关键操作节点的事件会被记录，按 trace_id 串成可追溯的证据链，同时生成向量索引和检索接口，供审计与回滚定位。运行脚本可产出 trace.jsonl、trace_summary.json 等留痕文件。
howto.when: 当多智能体系统需要全链路可观测与安全审计时，或在分发、扫描、解析等关键操作节点写入事件时。

say.text: 把这次分发和执行的每一步都写进证据链，用 trace_id 串起来。
say.note: 生成 evidence_chain 并留存事件。

say.text: 按 trace_id 查一下历史证据，看当时哪个官署做了什么。
say.note: 调用 query_api 检索证据链。

say.text: 运行 provenance 脚本，导出这次任务的全链路事件。
say.note: 产出 trace.jsonl 与汇总文件。

howto.what_en: Once installed, key operations from each agent are logged and chained into a trace_id-linked evidence chain, plus a vector index and query API for audit and rollback. Running the script outputs trace.jsonl and a summary.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a multi-agent system needs end-to-end observability and security audit, or at key nodes such as dispatch, scanning, and parsing.

say_en.text: Write every dispatch and execution step into the evidence chain, linked by trace_id.
say_en.note: Builds the evidence_chain and stores events.

say_en.text: Query historical evidence by trace_id to see which office did what.
say_en.note: Calls the query_api for the chain.

say_en.text: Run the provenance script to export this task's full event chain.
